subject.title: feat(gateway): session observer digests over the utility model

question: Should session observation ship enabled by default for all existing Control UI session subscribers, or should the first release require explicit opt-in until the utility-model privacy and cost posture is established?
rationale: This is an intentional new default and model-processing behavior, not a mechanical correctness question; tests cannot determine the desired upgrade, privacy, and operating-cost policy.

options.title: Approve the documented default-on posture
options.body: Keep `gateway.controlUi.sessionObserver` enabled by default after a maintainer accepts the model-data and provider-cost tradeoff and reviews live proof.

options.title: Launch as opt-in
options.body: Default observation off and require explicit configuration until the UI and operator-facing disclosure flow are available.

recommendation.title: Approve the documented default-on posture
recommendation.body: Keep `gateway.controlUi.sessionObserver` enabled by default after a maintainer accepts the model-data and provider-cost tradeoff and reviews live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR body contains the feature design and explicitly names the default-on tradeoff as a product decision.
